Thanks for the clear asks. We can absolutely accommodate a 12-month term with quarterly right-size checkpoints. High-level proposal I pulled together for our sync:

- Term & billing: 12-month term; quarterly usage True-Ups (banded threshold at 25% increments). Early-commit credit options if Kiln signs before June 20.
- Support: staged migration to Priority Support — Pilot week for oncall routing + runbook alignment, followed by full Priority activation on renewal Day 1.
- SLOs: Standard latency SLO stays the same; Priority Support adds 99.9% p99 token latency guard for production routes we pin. We’ll map 3 critical routes to the Priority lane.
- Price impact: estimate +22% on top of current committed rate for the Priority tier; we can reduce to +15% with a minimum committed throughput guarantee.

Attaching a migration playbook and a draft amendment w/ suggested language.

I have availability Wed 10:00–11:30 PT and Thu 14:00–16:00 PT for a 30-min call. What works?

Great meeting today — notes and next steps below. (Forwarding the amended language to procurement separately.)

Summary / agreed approach:

1) Term & right-sizing
- 12-month term starting 2027-07-01.
- Quarterly checkpoints (30-day window after quarter end) to reconcile usage. Banding: +/-25% no true-up; outside that we do pro-rata adjustments.
- Early-sign credit: sign by June 20 and receive one month credit applied pro-rata in Q3.

2) Priority Support migration
- Pilot week scheduled 2027-06-21 with a dedicated Priority slice (2 GPUs) to validate p99 latency on 3 pinned routes. Redwood will run synthetic validation and share raw metrics.
- Full activation: 2027-07-01 (renewal effective date) once pilot metrics hit agreed targets.
- Price uplift: +15% on committed rate if Kiln commits to a minimum 1.5x baseline monthly token volume for Q4; otherwise +22% on ad-hoc usage.

3) SLOs & Compliance
- Priority lane: 99.9% p99 token latency for pinned routes (measurement window: 24 hours rolling).
- Audit artifacts: SOC 2 summary and per-request trace logs will be provided to procurement; Redwood will redact sensitive content and provide a hashed index for traceability.

4) Contract language & next steps
- Marissa to send a DocuSign-ready amendment by EOD Fri (attached: proposed_amendment_v2.docx).
- Karthik to own the pilot validation plan and success criteria; Ben to manage runbook alignment and oncall handoff.
- Kiln to confirm minimum commit by June 20 to lock the +15% uplift and the early-sign credit.

Attachments: redwood_priority_migration_playbook.pdf (pilot checklist), proposed_amendment_v2.docx (DocuSign draft)

If procurement or legal need alternate wording on the right-sizing clause, loop me in and we'll iterate quickly.

Thanks everyone —
